articles.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) v5.6.5
articles.description:
What's new in v5.6.5-beta.1:

• Added zgit clone — download public GitHub repos as snapshots
• Fixed binary output rendering (cat on encrypted files now shows instantly)
• zrun now detects shebang and uses the correct interpreter
• zrun path resolution fixed (absolute, relative, ~, $HOME)
• Added verbose mode to zrun
